review_output: {"summary":"I reviewed only the five boundary files supplied. Authorization is correctly scoped: the one exported RichMenu action checks CSRF and requireVendorOwner before anything else, and it takes the vendor and actor from the session. The client-supplied previous state is only echoed back and never used for writes. Save and delete read the lock and then do a vendor-scoped revision check-and-write. The page and data shape never decrypt or expose secrets. I found one credential race to confirm with the core reviewer, one likely upload-size failure with the framework default, and three smaller problems where the screen can show the wrong status. This is not a Sandbox, browser or deployment pass.","findings":[{"severity":"MAJOR","file":"src/app/actions/line-actions.ts","area":"saveLineOfficialAccountAction transaction, `if(draft&&content&&publication)` branch","issue":"Credential saves only bump the draft revision when the draft already has a publication. For a draft that has never been synced (publication is null), switching channels or credentials leaves the draft row unchanged. A first sync that loaded the old credentials is then not stopped by the draft's revision/exact-JSON check.","evidence":"The draft update and revision increment run only when `publication` is truthy. Otherwise the transaction writes only lineOfficialAccount. The core's check-and-write is described as a row+exactJSON check on the draft, so it cannot see this change.","impact":"If a first sync runs at the same time as a credential save that switches to channel B, the sync can push the menu with the old channel A token. It can then record `synced` while the active account is B, and the page would say the menu is confirmed on LINE.","recommended_fix":"Whenever a draft exists, bump its revision in the same Serializable transaction, even when publication is null. Or confirm that the core re-reads and compares accountVersion inside the same Serializable transaction that writes `syncing`, and document that this is the guard.","required_test":"Two-transaction PG test: start a first sync (no publication), run a channel-switching credential save before the sync writes `syncing`, and check that the sync fails with conflict or not_configured and never records synced against the old account.","confidence":0.55},{"severity":"MAJOR","file":"src/app/actions/line-rich-menu-actions.ts","area":"publishIntent image upload via Server Action FormData","issue":"The image is sent through a Next.js Server Action. Its default request body limit is 1 MB, and the UI and LINE_RICH_MENU_IMAGE_LIMIT also allow up to 1 MB of image alone. No bodySizeLimit change is part of this scope.","evidence":"The UI says '最多 1 MB', and the server only rejects `image.size>LINE_RICH_MENU_IMAGE_LIMIT`. The multipart body also carries the menu JSON (up to 40 KB), the links, the CSRF token and the reference fields.","impact":"Valid images close to the limit will be rejected by the framework before the action runs. The user gets an uncaught action error or error boundary instead of `image_too_large`, so the documented limit cannot be reached.","recommended_fix":"Set experimental.serverActions.bodySizeLimit (or the current equivalent) above the image limit plus overhead, or lower the stated image limit so the whole body fits. Then check that oversize uploads map to `image_too_large`.","required_test":"Boundary test or browser check: a sync with a 1,048,576-byte PNG and the largest menu reaches syncLineRichMenuDraft, and a 1 MB+1 image returns image_too_large rather than a framework error.","confidence":0.5},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/app/actions/line-rich-menu-actions.ts","area":"updateRichMenuDraftAction catch block around publishIntent","issue":"If syncLineRichMenuDraft or reconcileLineRichMenuDraft throws (for example, a database error after the `syncing` checkpoint), the action returns `save_failed`, skips revalidatePath and returns no publication.","evidence":"The sync and reconcile return is inside the same try/catch as editDraft. The catch maps everything to `save_failed`, and revalidatePath only runs on the non-throw path.","impact":"The page shows the draft-save message ('目前無法儲存') and the stale unlocked view. It does not show the syncing or uncertain lock and reconcile button, even though the server state may now be locked. This is a UI accuracy gap; the server still enforces the lock.","recommended_fix":"Handle publish intents in their own try/catch. On error, call revalidatePath and return `sync_failed`, so the page remounts with the server's real publication state.","required_test":"Unit test: mock syncLineRichMenuDraft to throw after the checkpoint. Check that the result is sync_failed, revalidatePath was called, and the re-rendered page shows the locked or uncertain state with the reconcile control.","confidence":0.65},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/components/line-rich-menu-studio.tsx","area":"status/role=status feedback vs page.tsx `key=${draft.id}:${draft.revision}`","issue":"Every successful save, delete or revision-bumping sync triggers revalidatePath. That changes the Studio key, so the component remounts with the initial `idle` state and drops the action result. The '草稿已儲存' and '草稿已刪除…不會移除 LINE 目前的預設選單' messages, and any error returned along with a revision bump, are never shown.","evidence":"The page's Studio key is draft id plus revision. Save increments the revision, delete changes the key to 'new', and useActionState state is reset on remount.","impact":"Users get no confirmation for save or delete. They also miss the explicit warning that deleting the draft does not remove the live LINE default menu.","recommended_fix":"Keep the remount for stale-state safety, but show success and disclosure text from durable data: for example, keep the last action status in a parent keyed separately, or show the delete disclaimer as static copy next to the delete button.","required_test":"Browser or RTL test: save and then delete a draft, and check that the success and deletion disclaimer text is visible after revalidation.","confidence":0.6},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/app/actions/line-actions.ts","area":"testLineOfficialAccountAction lastValidatedAt update","issue":"The diagnostic reads the credentials, calls LINE, then sets lastValidatedAt with a vendor-only `update`. A credential save that happens in between resets lastValidatedAt to null, and this update then stamps the new, untested credentials as validated.","evidence":"The update is `where: { vendorId }` only, with no check against the account version or encrypted token that was actually tested.","impact":"The page can show '上次驗證' for credentials that were never validated, which is misleading after a credential rotation.","recommended_fix":"Use updateMany with the tested messagingAccessTokenEncrypted (or an account version) in the where clause, and treat count 0 as not validated.","required_test":"Interleaving test: start the test action, save new credentials before the update runs, and check that lastValidatedAt stays null.","confidence":0.6}]}
